details: BOMBARD. Treat the one centerline dorsal hardpoint as a large thick raised mortar for lobbed shots. Mount it on a very legible twin-cheek recoil carriage perched over the rear, pitched up enough to see its thick ring and single dark open mouth in a front three-quarter. Only one secondary, compact own-right machine gun below the deck. Give the own-left a low offset mustard cab with a teal windshield. Build a low cross-bridge on stout splayed, reverse-jointed walking legs, broad ground spades and a pair of graphite recoil links. Mustard/clay yellow structural castings and pale barrel bands. A clean angular field machine with broad paint planes.
